svg.title: Known-best packing of 183 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=183 construction, never the source witness: Evan Daniel's regularizer's view of it, its contacts re-solved exactly at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Only the original s183_h183b.cert at 3a9948c781be668b1547cc2bf64a0d1e614f9bca, admitted at expected n=183 with its exact rational side and all rows. The regularized certificate, same-packing identity, no-expansion path, numerical KKT or local-minimum diagnostics, rigidity, priority and global optimality are not decided by this replay.
